newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MICROLINK SELLING OFF ITS WHOLESALE ARM.
newsitem.headline: MICROLINK SELLING OFF ITS WHOLESALE ARM.

text.p: The largest computer assembly plant in Estonia is seeking to seeking to sell off its wholesale arm to American computer wholesaler CHS, Microlink said on Friday.

"The agreement was signed in Ocotber 1996, but CHS has not yet bought the stake in Microlink's wholesale arm, but they are expected to do this on January 1, 1998," Janek Oblikas, Microlink's marketing and sales director, told Reuters.
"CHS wanted time to consider the value of the company, because as an unlisted company, Microlink is hard to value," he added.
Olikas said that CHS will take over distribution of computers and components in Estonia and Mircolink wil continue to assemble computers to be distributed by CHS.
"As a distributor in Estonia CHS will also distribute computers not assembled by Microlink", Oblikas said.
